findings.symptom: Confirmed local TikZ render failure for both diagrams; raw diagram source is shown in place of the diagrams.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair the `tikzcd` source or supported diagram syntax so both route diagrams render; preserve the stated source/target objects and arrow labels.

findings.excerpt: The title renders `|0>` and `H|0>` as literal plain text rather than typeset ket notation.
findings.symptom: The title contains quantum state notation without math delimiters, unlike the typeset notation in the body.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the state expressions in the title, for example `$|0angle$` and `$H|0angle$`.

diagram_candidates.content: A three-stage circuit with Alice and Bob’s shared Bell pair |Φ+〉AB, Alice’s encoding gates X_A^b then Z_A^a, transmission of wire A, followed by Bob’s CNOT A→B and H_A, then ordered computational-basis measurements of A,B and output (a,b).
diagram_candidates.rationale: The procedure is a standard, highly recognizable two-qubit protocol, and the frozen source fixes the shared resource, gate order, wire roles, measurement order, and decoded bits. A circuit would make those maps and the resource transfer legible at a glance. This is explanatory; the complete procedure is already stated in prose.

diagram_candidates.content: Three wires A,B,C; input |ψ〉 on A and preshared |Φ+〉 on B,C; Alice applies CNOT A→B then H_A, measures A,B as ordered bits (a,b), sends both classical bits to Bob, and Bob applies X_C^b then Z_C^a to output on C.
diagram_candidates.rationale: This is the canonical teleportation protocol, with exact gate order, register order, classical feed-forward, and target wire specified in the source. An explicit circuit can show the quantum and classical maps and distinguish the preshared input resource from preparation. This is explanatory; prose already gives the full procedure.
concrete_maps: (a,b) measurement bits are sent to Bob in A,B order
correction map on C: Z_C^a X_C^b

diagram_map_or_sign_or_index_errors: The two hexagon diagrams do not render, so their arrows were checked against the source TeX and the typed equations in the adjacent statement/proof; no map, sign, or index mismatch was found in authored source.
